key_risks: Sudden de-escalation of US-Iran tensions causing oil and energy prices to reverse sharply
Hotter-than-expected June CPI on July 14 triggering broader equity selloff and higher yields
Weaker-than-expected major bank earnings weighing on financials and value
Continued low positive-asset breadth and risk-off flows amplifying equity declines

portfolio.invalidation_condition: De-escalation of US-Iran tensions or sharp reversal lower in oil prices
portfolio.rationale: Energy equities benefit from elevated oil prices driven by geopolitical supply risks in the Middle East and the announced blockade.
portfolio.time_window_catalyst: US blockade of Iranian shipping resumes July 14 and unresolved Strait of Hormuz control disputes

portfolio.invalidation_condition: Rapid resolution of shipping disruptions or oil price collapse on de-escalation
portfolio.rationale: Direct crude exposure positioned for further upside if Hormuz transit risks and blockade effects persist or intensify.
portfolio.time_window_catalyst: Blockade resumption July 14 and ongoing Hormuz control/transit uncertainties

portfolio.invalidation_condition: Disappointing bank earnings results or emerging credit quality concerns
portfolio.rationale: Major bank Q2 results provide a concrete near-term catalyst; sector shows relative resilience and benefits from higher yields.
portfolio.time_window_catalyst: JPMorgan Chase and Wells Fargo Q2 earnings releases scheduled July 14

portfolio.invalidation_condition: Broad risk-off equity selloff or sharp rotation back into growth/tech
portfolio.rationale: Value tilt provides relative stability and indirect exposure to financials/energy-sensitive names amid rate and commodity volatility; recent active returns positive.

portfolio_rationale: Portfolio concentrates on energy and oil to capture the primary identifiable near-term catalyst from Hormuz/blockade developments while adding financials for the bank earnings event and large-value for relative resilience and diversification. This structure targets positive absolute return and alpha versus an expected flat-to-negative SPY amid mixed data and geopolitical uncertainty.
rationale_summary: Overweight energy complex for Middle East shipping risks starting July 14, financials for scheduled earnings, and large value for defensive relative strength; avoids high-vol tech/semis given recent weakness and lack of positive catalysts.
